name: Yarus
description: Yarus is a Gruul centaur who speaks for the Gruul clans and claims the god Anzrag as the Gruul's responsibility.

summary.text: Yarus is a Gruul centaur who speaks for the Gruul clans and claims the god Anzrag as the Gruul's responsibility.

bio.text: Yarus was dragged off the balcony shouting that Anzrag must be returned to the Gruul.

timeline.summary: Yarus is dragged off the balcony shouting that Anzrag must be returned to the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Anzrag is our responsibility, our god, and he must be returned to us!

timeline.summary: Ezrim orders agents to fetch Yarus, whom he blames for the breakout.
timeline.quote: Find Yarus and bring him back here. I know he had something to do with this.

timeline.quote: Yarus didn't release Anzrag from the evidence capsule

timeline.summary: Tolsimir intercepts Yarus's charge and is impaled on the rafter.
